description: Census Mortgage and Rent Affordability Indicators for LGAs and SA2s is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) and Regional Data Hub. These tables provide counts of households according to indicators of mortgage and rent affordability, crossed with equivalised household income. The data is sourced from Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Census of Population and Housing data for 2011, 2016, and 2021. The data is aggregated to 2021 Local Government Area (LGA), Statistical Area Level 2 (SA2), and state and territory geographies. Coverage is Australia, 2011 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-13. Files and pages listed: CSV, XLSX, ZIP (8 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
